title: Magneto-optic quadrilayer at 830 nm
source: M. Mansuripur, J. Appl. Phys. 67, 6466-6475 (1990), Section VI and Figs. 2-3
notes: Every input is printed in the paper. The paper uses exp[i(k.r - wt)] and n + ik, as this program does, so nothing is converted. Its stated results: at normal incidence about 91% of the incident power is absorbed in the MO layer, 3% in the aluminium, and 6% is reflected (Fig. 3); |r_ps| = |r_sp| at every angle (Fig. 2a). The second SiOx layer is 'another quarter-wave-thick layer', so 143.2 nm like the first.
